items.prompt: A phone costs Rp1.800.000. The shop gives a 15% discount. What is the sale price in rupiah?
hints: Take the discount from the price.

items.prompt: After a 20% rise, a bag of rice costs Rp54.000. What did the bag cost before the rise, in rupiah?
hints: Rp54.000 is 120% of the old price.
The old price is 100%, which is 10 of those parts.
items.explanation: 120% of the old price is 54.000, so 10% is 4.500. Then 100% is 45.000, and the old price was Rp45.000.

items.prompt: A jacket costs Rp100.000. The price goes up by 10%, then the new price goes down by 10%. What is the final price?
hints: Do the rise first: find 110% of Rp100.000.
After the rise the price is Rp110.000.
items.explanation: After the rise it is Rp110.000. 10% of that is Rp11.000, so the final price is Rp99.000.

options.why: The 10% fall is taken from a bigger amount, so it takes off more than the rise added.
The fall is not 10% of the old price. It is 10% of the higher price.
This ignores the rise. The two changes are done one after the other.
